profiles_by_preset.master: Final-year Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering undergraduate at IOE, Kathmandu Engineering College, combining applied machine learning, edge AI, formal verification, and distributed systems tooling. Fusemachines AI Fellow and NSSR DataCamp Fellow. Builds reproducible end-to-end systems spanning statistical bias auditing, quantized on-device neural inference, SMT-based state machine verification, and multi-agent coordination engines. Experienced with deterministic evaluation pipelines and production APIs.
profiles_by_preset.research: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering undergraduate specializing in empirical AI safety, mechanistic interpretability, and formal verification of agentic systems. Fusemachines AI Fellow co-developing intersectional demographic fairness audit frameworks with statistical confidence intervals (AIF360, Fairlearn). Experienced in Z3 SMT invariant verification, Bayesian inference (PyMC/ArviZ), and quantized edge model evaluation.
profiles_by_preset.systems: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering undergraduate specializing in embedded AI, low-level systems programming, and deterministic control. Technical lead for SPARK (ESP32-S3 wearable fall detection running quantized 18.5 KB INT8 CNNs under FreeRTOS), developer of Windows DFIR stealth-evasion triage engines, and kernel-level NTFS privacy tooling. Experienced in C/C++, Win32 APIs, RTOS, and protocol verification.
profiles_by_preset.aiml: Final-year engineering undergraduate and Fusemachines AI Fellow building applied ML pipelines, vision evaluation frameworks, and production agentic services. Engineered a 5-stage Text-to-SQL engine with 100% benchmark execution accuracy, demographic fairness auditing over 97K images, and full-stack microservices using FastAPI, Docker, and PostgreSQL. Experienced in PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and MLOps.
profiles_by_preset.fullstack: Final-year engineering student building autonomous multi-agent developer tooling, distributed orchestration harnesses, and high-performance system utilities. Architect of Fleet-Orchestrator (multi-account agent fleet with SQLite WAL lease machines), custom MCP servers (NotebookLM, LocalSend, CAD), and cross-IDE configuration synchronizers.
profiles_by_preset.compact: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering student and Fusemachines AI Fellow. Builds reproducible applied ML, edge AI (ESP32-S3 / TFLite Micro), and formally verified systems. Experienced across PyTorch, C/C++, FastAPI, Docker, and Z3 SMT.

fellowships.title: Fuse AI Fellow
fellowships.summary: Selected for prestigious, intensive AI engineering fellowship covering ML, computer vision, NLP, and production MLOps.

bullets.text: Engineered a five-stage agentic Text-to-SQL pipeline (Planner → Generator → Validator → Executor → Summarizer), achieving **100% execution success and answer accuracy** on a 50-question project benchmark.
Built containerized AI microservices and evaluation APIs using **FastAPI**, **PostgreSQL**, and **Docker**.
Developed customer churn and lifetime value (CLV) prediction pipelines (**5-fold CV ROC-AUC 0.841**) utilizing **SMOTE**, cost-sensitive threshold tuning, and **SHAP** explainability.
Conducted Bayesian estimation and Gaussian-process regression with **PyMC/ArviZ**, and performed unsupervised segmentation (**K-Means**, **DBSCAN**) on **~500K retail transaction records**.
Assembled a four-model time-series forecasting ensemble achieving **MASE 2.44** on the UCI Online Retail II dataset.

fellowships.title: NSSR DataCamp Fellow (Cohort 2)
fellowships.summary: Awarded competitive sponsored fellowship for advanced data science and generative AI pathways.

bullets.text: Selected in competitive cohort for sponsored DataCamp access; developed six applied GenAI solutions automating data cleaning, schema normalization, and null filtering.
Completed advanced **SQL Associate** and **Python Data Associate** coursework focused on PostgreSQL, Pandas, and inferential statistics.

projects.title: BiasAperture — Computer Vision Demographic Fairness & Bias Audit
projects.summary: Diagnostic fairness-auditing framework measuring demographic parity and predictive disparities across granular intersectional groups in computer vision.

bullets.text: Co-developed an automated fairness-auditing framework with dual **AIF360** and **Fairlearn** backends computing **Disparate Impact Ratio (DIR)**, **Demographic Parity Difference (DPD)**, **Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD)**, and **Equalized Odds**.

Audited classification performance across **126 granular race × age × gender groups** on the **FairFace benchmark (97,698 images)**, discovering significant disparity drop-offs across intersectional distribution shifts.

Implemented rigorous statistical inference: **BCa bootstrap confidence intervals (B ≥ 1,000)**, **χ² and Fisher's exact tests**, **n ≥ 30 sample-size safeguards**, and **Shapley feature attribution (SHAP)** for flagged discrepancies.
Architected clean CLI, HTML/PDF reporting pipelines, and modular test harnesses with **78/78 passing repository tests**; co-authored with Tisha Manandhar.

projects.title: SPARK — Safety-Critical Wearable Edge-AI Fall Detection System
projects.summary: Two-stage embedded safety wearable combining deterministic kinematic thresholding with a quantized 1D-CNN confirmation layer on ESP32-S3.

bullets.text: Technical lead for ML modeling, quantization, and gateway architecture in a four-person team; designed a two-tier fall detection system eliminating cloud latency and privacy hazards.

Trained 1D-CNN on the **SisFall benchmark (38 subjects, 38,420 windows)**; achieved **0.9185 AUC-ROC (95% CI: [0.9065, 0.9305])** and **87.81% sensitivity** under subject-stratified 5-fold cross-validation with zero data leakage.
Executed post-training integer quantization (PTQ), compressing model flash memory footprint to **18.5 KB** for deterministic, **sub-100ms** on-device confirmation on the **ESP32-S3** microcontroller.

Engineered BLE/serial local gateway, local **SHAP feature attribution**, FastAPI REST event store, and automated clinical incident PDF report generation; verified by **56 host CTest/Unity unit tests** and **48 Python integration tests**.

projects.title: Headless Invariant Assurance Engine (INV-BMK-001)
projects.summary: Formal verification harness encoding state-machine contracts into SMT-LIB2 / Z3 formal logic to inductively prove invariants and replay counterexamples.

bullets.text: Developed a formal verification benchmark encoding reactive state-machine contracts into **SMT-LIB2/Z3**, inductively proving candidate safety invariants and generating executable counterexamples.

Evaluated **12 safety properties across 4 state machines**, discovering and sandbox-replaying **4/4 planted violations (100% recall, 0.0% false-discovery rate)** with **10.844 ms mean solver latency**.

projects.title: Fleet-Orchestrator — Multi-Account Autonomous Agent Swarm & Consensus Engine
projects.summary: Distributed multi-agent orchestration engine coordinating 31 worker accounts with SQLite WAL lease state machines and automated quota management.

bullets.text: Architected an autonomous multi-agent coordinator managing background worker swarms across **31 Copilot accounts** with atomic **SQLite WAL lease state machines** and crash recovery.
Implemented multi-provider adapters (Copilot CLI, Gemini, Claude, local SLMs), quota-aware round-robin scheduling, and adversarial lease-stealing tests.

projects.title: Cyber-Forensics — Windows DFIR Stealth-Evasion Triage Engine
projects.summary: DFIR triage toolkit hunting evasive persistence and masqueraded payloads across Windows NTFS internals.

bullets.text: Built a high-performance Windows DFIR triage engine detecting hidden **NTFS Alternate Data Streams (ADS)**, **CLSID and Unicode RLO masquerades**, and **PE header anomalies**.
Automated Prefetch execution artifact harvesting and maintained tamper-evident chain-of-custody evidence ledgers for rapid security triage.

projects.title: Win-Vault — Kernel-Level NTFS Folder Privacy Engine
projects.summary: Folder privacy utility enforcing kernel-level access denial via native NTFS Access Control Lists with zero third-party dependencies.

bullets.text: Engineered a zero-dependency Windows folder locking utility enforcing kernel-level access denial via native **NTFS Access Control Lists (ACLs)** and **SHA-256** password hashing.

projects.title: Super-NLM — Multi-Account NotebookLM Aggregator & MCP Hub
projects.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and dashboard for multi-account Google NotebookLM management and cross-notebook synthesis.

bullets.text: Developed an MCP stdio/HTTP server and dashboard enabling multi-account NotebookLM access with round-robin rotation, quota-aware backoff, and cross-notebook synthesis.
Automated Google Drive folder synchronization and batch generation of Studio artifacts (audio overviews, study guides, mind maps).

projects.title: Agent-Customization-Sync — Cross-IDE Configuration Synchronizer
projects.summary: Automated synchronization engine maintaining cryptographic ring-buffer backups and rules transpilation across Antigravity, Cursor, and Claude Code.

bullets.text: Engineered cross-IDE configuration synchronizer providing snapshotting, rules transpilation, and **SHA-256 drift auditing** across Antigravity, Cursor, and Claude Code.

projects.title: Gesture-Controlled Self-Balancing Robot (GCSBR)
projects.summary: Two-wheeled inverted pendulum robot with PID stabilization firmware and real-time Android computer-vision gesture actuation.

bullets.text: Implemented real-time **PID stabilization firmware** on an inverted pendulum robot, validated via a MATLAB-simulation-to-hardware parameter transfer pipeline.
Developed an Android companion app (**Kotlin**, **MediaPipe Hands**, **CameraX**, **Bluetooth**) mapping hand gestures to directional actuation commands in real time.

projects.title: Edge AI Stability Detection System
projects.summary: Random Forest telemetry classifier predicting platform stability from simulated IMU sensor streams.

bullets.text: Trained a Random Forest classifier predicting platform stability from simulated 6-axis IMU streams, reaching **99.8% test accuracy**.
Serialized the pipeline via Joblib and deployed an ultra-low-latency **FastAPI REST inference endpoint** for robotics integration.

projects.title: nepali-ocr-ai — Low-Resource Document Intelligence

bullets.text: Prototyped a hybrid Nepali document intelligence pipeline combining vision LLM OCR with local Tesseract fallback, Devanagari normalization, and Preeti ↔ Unicode transcoding.

projects.title: Nexus — Personal AI Workspace & Knowledge Retrieval Hub

bullets.text: Architected a local AI workspace integrating multi-model API backends with **SQLite FTS5 full-text search** for sub-15ms semantic note retrieval.
Engineered responsive frontend with React, Vite, and WebSocket streaming for low-latency conversational interaction.

projects.title: Win-Governor / System-Optimizer — Workstation Memory Reclamation Engine

bullets.text: Built a native Windows performance utility reclaiming **1.2–3.4 GB working-set RAM** under heavy developer workloads via undocumented Win32/NT APIs.

projects.title: Utility MCP Suite — LocalSend, Google Classroom & Fusion 360 Bridges

bullets.text: Developed **localsend-mcp** enabling AI agents to discover LAN peers and transfer multi-gigabyte build artifacts over secure mTLS (<25ms transport latency).
Built **fusion360-mcp** establishing a headless IPC bridge to Autodesk Fusion 360 for agentic 3D parametric CAD modeling.
